oracles.scenario: Duplicate event_id at disjoint timestamps
oracles.expected: VALIDATION_REJECTED, zero ticks; E_DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID

oracles.scenario: Two different valid control bodies same tick (LOW and HIGH)
oracles.expected: E_CONTROL_BATCH_CONFLICT; no accepted LOW/HIGH or age refresh

oracles.scenario: Different IDs, same semantic payload same tick
oracles.expected: one observation; IDs sorted; latest original timestamp

oracles.scenario: Valid LOW + typed invalid UART in same tick
oracles.expected: no qualifying LOW; E_FRAME_INVALID

oracles.scenario: Same-tick healthy and lost
oracles.expected: LOST effective; no arm or active output

oracles.scenario: ACTIVE + RF LOST + RESET
oracles.expected: CONTINGENCY, null output

oracles.scenario: ACTIVE + catastrophe + RESET
oracles.expected: FAULT_LATCHED, cannot clear in-run

oracles.scenario: CONTINGENCY + second LOW completing window + ACK
oracles.expected: deny ACK this tick; remain CONTINGENCY

oracles.scenario: CONTINGENCY + committed LOW + eligible ACK, all sources restored
oracles.expected: DISARMED, LOW consumed, no rearm

oracles.scenario: Two distinct IDs equivalent ACK same tick
oracles.expected: one logical ACK; no double recovery

oracles.scenario: LOW at 15ms; invalid at 25ms; LOW at 35ms
oracles.expected: new LOW is first; window not completed

oracles.scenario: HIGH first at 40ms; confirm 139999us or 140000us
oracles.expected: 139999 no qualification; 140000 yes with healthy preconditions

oracles.scenario: ACTIVE, no new control, both ages <=200ms
oracles.expected: held authorized effort; no timestamp refresh

oracles.scenario: ACTIVE, no new control, age >200ms
oracles.expected: CONTINGENCY and (null,null)

oracles.scenario: SELF_TEST, policy approved and no critical health issue, RF unknown
oracles.expected: DISARMED but no ARM

oracles.scenario: Unrecognized voltage recovery event type in input v1
oracles.expected: VALIDATION_REJECTED; do not invent event schema

oracles.scenario: CONTINGENCY with scheduler stalled, ACK after RF healthy
oracles.expected: no ACK-clear

oracles.scenario: Scenario includes approved=true and false trusted allowlist
oracles.expected: preflight rejection, no sink

oracles.scenario: terminal contains control_trace_sha256
oracles.expected: nonconforming complete trace; reject

oracles.scenario: ACTIVE tick append fails before publish
oracles.expected: no new output, FAILED_INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, complete SHA null

oracles.scenario: same scenario/policy/engine/schedule, different execution-instance UUID
oracles.expected: same normative trace bytes and digest

oracles.scenario: one byte changed in canonical approved policy
oracles.expected: mismatched digest rejected at preflight

oracles.scenario: SIM JSON asks real servo PWM/FLIGHT_TEST_APPROVED
oracles.expected: preflight E_CONTEXT_DENIED; no hardware adapter

oracles.scenario: E_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT ambiguous legacy result
oracles.expected: no silent alias to v2; report AMBIGUOUS_LEGACY_ERROR

oracles.scenario: compare head and prepended notices against blob guards
oracles.expected: all sources match or freeze BLOCKED

oracles.scenario: frame or RF age equals 200000 vs 200001µs
oracles.expected: exact boundary allowed; +1 fails if active

oracles.scenario: ARM_CHECK 100ms timer tick but no confirming HIGH frame
oracles.expected: does not reach ARMED_IDLE

oracles.scenario: normal complete run expected fault injection and full terminal
oracles.expected: can report COMPLETED; PASS only if oracle matches
